summary: Angle bays beside a sports field, packed with parked cars, no homes.
reasons: Cars parked nose to kerb all along

best_section.where: west edge of Walcott Street, in the angle bays beside the playing field

drivers.seclusion: Playing field and trees to the west; non-residential university stores 14 m or more east; no dwellings mapped.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with angle bays on the west edge, filled with cars; the section is just over one van length.
drivers.traffic: Light campus traffic; lane serves stores and a depot.
drivers.convention: Signed 4P angle parking; a dense row of cars is parked, so a van blends in.

flags: Section is short, about one van length
sun_shade: Open to the sky; tree line on the west gives some afternoon shade.
rubbish: Scrap in the yard across the road; none on the kerb.
